comment: LAST BELL audio overrides. Drop an mp3 into assets/audio/ using the exact filename from SOUND_FILES in audio.js (see ELEVENLABS_ASSET_REQUESTS.md), then add its sound id to "available". Only listed ids are fetched; anything missing or undecodable silently falls back to the procedural sound. Optional "files": { "<id>": "assets/audio/<file>.mp3" } adds or renames ids (e.g. music_calm, music_tension). "probeAll": true tries every known file (404s expected). PA songs (SCHOOLNET → PA System): put your own mp3s in assets/audio/songs/ and list them in "songs" as { "file": "assets/audio/songs/my-song.mp3", "title": "My song" }; they appear after the built-in music boxes.
